role: Immutable Caduceus release verification flag for one Forgejo release and its four profile digests
description: The immutable release.flag Forgejo Release asset for Caduceus. sha256 is the SHA256 of the compact UTF-8 serialization json.dumps(profile_digest_map, separators=(",", ":")), with profile_digest_map inserted in publisher PROFILES order (homeserver, console, tv, probe), and with no trailing newline. Unknown fields are tolerated and preserved by readers; a reader refuses a foreign schema id or any missing required field.

evolution.law: additive-only; missing declared field is a refusal; unknown fields are skipped without reconstructing or discarding the raw existing record
